definitions.compression: Saty pivot-ribbon BB/Keltner squeeze on continuous 3m close
definitions.base: first afternoon run of >= min_base_bars 3m compression bars
definitions.pump: first post-base bar high > base range high
definitions.flush: first post-base bar low < base range low
